capabilities: apply tags to notes based on vault-relative paths
match paths with regex or glob rules
merge tags into existing YAML frontmatter without duplicates
preview and test matching before writing files
run rules on a file, folder, or the whole vault
extras: The plugin directory listing notes that it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to derive tags from where a note sits in the folder structure, so tagging by location must be done by hand.
summary: Rule-based plugin that adds YAML frontmatter tags to Markdown notes automatically from their folder paths, with regex or glob patterns.
